records.observation: Constructor Object only. setTimeBoundingBox obtains category array, sorts with INCL_RATIO_ORDER then iterates reverse: each category earliest=start and duration=(end-start)*getCategoryRatio(true); overlapping common origin, not cumulative stacking. Mutates category boxes; no ratio normalization/clamp or time-order/finite checks. Comparator implementation/array aliasing not established here. Static log base10, ten BasicStroke widths1..10. Setter stores any int as long; getArrowStroke rounds average real-object count to long, repeatedly integer-divides by base until quotient0 or ten iterations, selects index clamped tolast. Default gives widths1 for rounded0..9,2 for10..99 etc, capped10. Base0 throws ArithmeticException; base1 nonzero counts hit cap, negative values unchecked, loop bounded. draw obtains array and stroke, accesses last element without empty guard, derives row/time slope from its duration without zero guard. Traverses categories reverse, draws each category color from its earliest time/start row to its latest time/interpolated row; common baseline assumed from prior preparation. Does not call setTimeBoundingBox internally or sort there. Returns sum of attempted line calls. drawForward is line-only (no arrowhead/DrawnBox); converts coords, clips relevant x sides to0 and imageWidth with Math.rint, strict sourceX>0/destinationX<width flags, equal-x returns0 only if clipping needed. No complete outside rejection/y clipping, unchecked int coordinate differences. Optional stroke restored only normal path, color left last category. containsPixel uses same last-element slope and category array forward iteration, delegates Line.containsPixel (fixed tolerance independent of drawn stroke width), returns whole TimeAveBox on first hit, not category, else null. No viewport or visible-category validation. Empty arrays fail in both draw/containsPixel; zero reference duration propagates infinity/NaN to coordinate transformation. Statistics and category generation internals remain separate reading obligations.
